help.title: How to play
help.intro: One player is the imposter — they don't know the secret word. Everyone else does.
steps: Host enters first names and shares the link (copy or QR).
Each player opens the link and taps their name, then show role.
Take turns: each player says one word describing the secret word — without naming it. Loop until someone is accused, or the imposter shouts the word.
Accuse by show of hands. If it's the imposter, they get one last guess at the word: right = imposter wins, wrong = innocents win.
Tap reveal imposter to confirm, then next round.
